		Introduction
	

We propose FinMCP-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark for
evaluating LLMs’ ability to invoke MCP tools in financial
scenarios. It contains 613 samples across 10 main scenar-
ios and 33 sub-scenarios, including real and synthetic user
queries, with three sample types: single tool, multi-tool, and multi-turn, allowing evaluation across different levels of task… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/DianJin/FinMCP-Bench.
reputation: Emerging benchmark focused on LLM tool invocation in financial scenarios; limited but growing adoption among financial-NLP and tool-integration researchers.
